From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust.

It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

In this role, you will join the Bank’s new place‑based (Local Growth) team, taking responsibility for shaping and directing place‑based activity within the North East Region.
Working locally and in close partnership with the North East Director, you will develop a tailored regional strategy and delivering meaningful outcomes by engaging with the local market investment teams, central resources, and drawing on your own personal commercial experience.

This includes identifying, catalysing, and facilitating commercial opportunities focused on the region’s priority Industrial Strategy sectors, including connecting finance providers with clusters of high‑potential businesses to drive measurable growth in local financing and business activity.

A core element of the role is fostering a local finance ecosystem that enables innovative, high‑potential businesses to access the right finance, regardless of location or stage of development. The position also leverages the Bank’s expertise in small business access to finance, alongside its extensive networks of finance providers and investors.

You will need to establish credibility quickly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, from investment professionals to local leaders and politicians, in order to facilitate the development, negotiation and implementation of initiatives that drive change and growth within the region.

You will bring commercial experience in accessing and/or delivering equity or debt finance, together, with a credible technical and strategic understanding of how investment decisions are made and how capital flows into local markets. This experience may have been gained within a finance provider, or as a founder or business operator.

You will also have a proven ability to act as a strategic partner to external stakeholders, influencing decision‑makers at both operational and strategic levels. Experience of working with, convening and developing investor networks would be a distinct advantage.

Excellent analytical capability is essential, including confidence in working with quantitative and qualitative data to produce compelling, insightful materials that inform strategy, support stakeholder engagement, and contribute to the delivery of measurable and impactful outcomes.

You will play a leading role in convening investors across the North East, strengthening connections between private capital, public finance institutions, innovation clusters and high-growth businesses, while helping to attract new sources of investment into the region.

Harvard Business Publishing (HBP) – the leading destination for innovative management thinking. We reach lifelong learners to improve the practice of management in a changing world. This mission inspires each of us to unlock the leader in everyone – including you!

The opportunity About Organization: At Harvard Business Impact, we are passionate about excellence in business education. We partner with Higher Education institutions, educators and students around the world to deliver best-in-class learning experiences that develop leaders who are ready for a changing world.

We provide cases, simulations, articles, online courses, and emerging AI-enabled learning tools to higher education institutions worldwide.

We support faculty and program leads through pedagogical support, teaching advice, and curriculum guidance to help them create dynamic and powerful learning moments that students will remember long after they leave the classroom.

Position Overview: Harvard Business Impact is seeking a dynamic and experienced Regional Director to lead and expand our presence across the Middle East higher education sector.

This role calls for an accomplished commercial and relationship leader who can act as a player-coach —personally driving strategic opportunities while leading and developing a small regional team .

The Regional Director will own the regional strategy and performance for the Middle East , building trusted relationships internally and externally, orchestrating complex multi-stakeholder engagements, and collaborating across global teams.

As the senior representative of Harvard Business Impact in the region, the Regional Director will play a critical role in shaping regional strategy, strengthening partnerships with leading institutions, and ensuring strong execution aligned with global priorities.

The Regional Director must be comfortable engaging at the highest levels—including chancellors, vice-chancellors, presidents, deans, senior government officials, and board-level decision makers—to support our expansion across the Middle East.

This role requires an entrepreneurial mindset, strong consultative selling expertise, and a passion for education , including the ability to advise institutions navigating rapid change in teaching, learning, and educational leadership, particularly the growing role of artificial intelligence in higher education.

This is an opportunity to lead Harvard Business Impact’s growth in the Middle East and shape the future of higher education in the region. The Regional Director will work closely with the Senior Director EMEA & APAC to shape regional growth strategy, expand market presence, and achieve revenue targets within the higher education sector.

What you'll do Regional Leadership & Market Development
Own and drive Harvard Business Impact’s growth across the Middle East region, identifying strategic opportunities and building long-term institutional partnerships
Build and manage relationships with senior academic leaders and government stakeholders, including chancellors, presidents, deans, and ministry officials
Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of partnerships and position HBI as a trusted long-term partner for universities navigating digital transformation and AI adoption
Lead, mentor, and support a small regional team, fostering accountability, collaboration and alignment with global strategy
Sales Strategy & Strategic Engagement
Develop and execute the regional sales strategy to achieve revenue targets and expand HBI’s institutional footprint
Lead complex consultative engagements with universities and government institutions, aligning HBI’s solutions—including cases, simulations, articles, and digital learning offerings—to institutional needs
Guide institutions through the full partnership journey, from initial engagement and solution design to negotiation and long-term collaboration
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Market Insight
Partner with global teams across marketing, product, and customer success to ensure coordinated engagement and delivery of value to institutions
Monitor market trends, institutional priorities, and competitive dynamics to inform strategy and provide insights to internal leadership
Represent Harvard Business Impact at key regional conferences, academic forums, and industry events to strengthen relationships and generate new opportunities.
Reporting & Strategic Alignment
Provide regular updates on regional performance, pipeline development, and market insights to senior leadership
Ensure strong alignment between regional activities and HBI’s global strategy through transparent communication and collaboration

Minimum of 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or commercial leadership within education, publishing, professional services, or related sectors
Proven track record managing complex institutional sales cycles and building long-term partnerships with universities or government stakeholders
Experience developing and executing regional growth strategies
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior academic leaders, institutional executives, and government stakeholders

Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to operate independently in a regional leadership role
Experience working within complex, hierarchical environments and negotiating high-value partnerships
Ability to operate as a player-coach , balancing hands-on engagement with leadership and development of a regional team
Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills
Growth mindset, adaptability, and intellectual curiosity
Deep understanding of Middle Eastern business culture and engagement practices
Familiarity with higher-education systems and the evolving landscape of digital and active learning solutions

Interest in the impact of artificial intelligence and digital transformation in higher education
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

WIZE is the leading all-in-one Portfolio Management System for Swiss boutique wealth managers, External Asset Managers, and family offices.

Founded in Geneva in 2010, WIZE has earned a trusted position in a relationship-driven market through deep product capability and a differentiated back-office outsourcing service that competitors have not replicated.

The company operates on a highly recurring subscription model, holds a strong position within its vertical, and is in excellent operating shape.

WIZE is now entering its first chapter of international ownership under Banyan Software, combining more than fifteen years of product depth and client trust with the operational and AI expertise of a global software group.
The Opportunity
You will join WIZE directly as Managing Director, United Kingdom, reporting to the CEO of WIZE, with responsibility for establishing and growing the UK business. This is a value-creation mandate, not a turnaround. . You will take the business into a new market, with the United Kingdom as the primary prize. The product has to remain the primary competitive advantage, the recurring revenue base has to be protected, and the opportunity to create structural distance through AI is real.
You will own the UK client and partner relationships, build the commercial motion from the ground up, and partner with the CEO and product and technology leader to ensure the platform addresses the needs of the UK market.
You will have substantial authority over the execution of the agreed UK strategy. Key commercial development decisions, including market positioning, target segments, pricing, partnerships, resource allocation, and major commercial commitments, will be decided jointly with the CEO.
You will do this with the long-term backing of a permanent-capital owner, free from the pressure to flip the business.

Commercial & Revenue Growth
Build the foundation of the UK subsidiary and work closely with the CEO to define WIZE's expansion into the UK market.
Own the execution of WIZE's UK strategy, market positioning, and competitive response in the wealth management software market.
Drive UK revenue and ARR growth with direct accountability across new customer acquisition, expansion, pricing execution, and the development of recurring revenue.
Build and execute the UK go-to-market motion from the ground up: local presence, bank and partner relationships, and a repeatable pipeline where little exists today.

Contribute to a credible AI roadmap. AI must be embedded as a genuine operational and product advantage, not a roadmap line item.
Champion AI-first product thinking, identifying where automation, predictive insights, and intelligent workflows create durable differentiation for UK clients.
Partner closely with the CEO and CPTO so that the roadmap, packaging, and pricing tiers align tightly with UK commercial needs.
Gather structured feedback from UK prospects, clients, and partners and translate it into clear commercial and product recommendations.
Team & Operations
Define and implement the UK commercial development strategy jointly with the CEO.
Oversee the UK financial performance, budgeting, and resource allocation to ensure sustainable profitability. Prepare and manage the UK commercial budget and resource plan, subject to approval by the CEO and Chief Revenue Officer, to ensure sustainable growth.

Examples of qualifying specialized experience include: Working member of a functioning joint apprenticeship committee. Employer training official or officer of a union or trade association whose duties included the development or administration of an apprenticeship program or other industrial training program.

Coordinator or director of a training program for apprenticeable occupations or other training activities. Training representative or administrator in the field of apprenticeship, working with labor or management. Vocational teacher or instructor in an apprenticeable occupation.

Specialized Experience is the experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSA's) to perform the duties of the position successfully, and that is typically in or related to the position to be filled.

To be creditable, specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level.
